title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em foz do iguaçu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:

Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)  Location: LATAM   Duration: 6-12months   Job Summary:   We are looking for a  Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.  Key Responsibilities:   ·Work with business stakeholders to  gather, analyze, and document business requirements  for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.  ·Translate business needs into  functional requirements, user stories, and process flows  .  ·Act as a  bridge between business teams and technical teams  to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.  ·Configure and support Salesforce features including  Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards  .  ·Participate in  solution design discussions  and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.  ·Support  UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.  ·Assist in  data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation  .  ·Provide  production support and troubleshooting  for Salesforce issues.  ·Maintain clear documentation including  BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams  .  ·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive  continuous improvement and system optimization  .  Required Qualifications:   ·3–6 years of experience  as a Business Analyst with  Salesforce platform exposure  .  ·Strong understanding of  Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud  .  ·Experience with  requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management  .  ·Knowledge of  Agile/Scrum methodologies  .  ·Ability to create  user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications  .  ·Experience with  Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration  .  ·Strong  analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em curitiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description:
Empresa está contratando Risk management officer em garibaldi. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Job Title:  Implementation Analyst English Resume Only  Location:  Brazil  Type:  Full-Time Contract  Setup:  Fully Remote  Level:  Mid-Level  Industry:  Software SAAS Company  Shift:  US Hours  Start Date:  can start in 2 weeks after offer  Equipment:  Available upon request  Rate:  R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group   The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.  About the Opportunity   Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.  The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.  Responsibilities   Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.  Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.  Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.  Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.  Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.  Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.  Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.  Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.  Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.    Qualifications   At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.  Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.  Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.  Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.  Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.  Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.  Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.  Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.  Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical product owner em itajaí. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Job Title:  Implementation Analyst English Resume Only  Location:  Brazil  Type:  Full-Time Contract  Setup:  Fully Remote  Level:  Mid-Level  Industry:  Software SAAS Company  Shift:  US Hours  Start Date:  can start in 2 weeks after offer  Equipment:  Available upon request  Rate:  R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group   The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.  About the Opportunity   Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.  The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.  Responsibilities   Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.  Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.  Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.  Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.  Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.  Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.  Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.  Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.  Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.    Qualifications   At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.  Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.  Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.  Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.  Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.  Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.  Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.  Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.  Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

description:

As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking  Web3 & AI Investment Analyst  to join our team. Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities. Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.  Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.  Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.  Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.  Fluent English with strong written communication skills.  High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.     Why Join Web3 DXB  Competitive compensation:  BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.   Remote-first:  Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.   Direct investment exposure:  Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.   High-growth environment:  Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.   Meritocratic culture:  Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.  Long-term upside:  Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.    If you’re passionate about  Web3, AI, and investing  , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Empresa está contratando Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em brusque. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
Confira a vaga para Technical product owner em passo fundo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)  Location: LATAM   Duration: 6-12months   Job Summary:   We are looking for a  Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.  Key Responsibilities:   ·Work with business stakeholders to  gather, analyze, and document business requirements  for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.  ·Translate business needs into  functional requirements, user stories, and process flows  .  ·Act as a  bridge between business teams and technical teams  to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.  ·Configure and support Salesforce features including  Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards  .  ·Participate in  solution design discussions  and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.  ·Support  UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.  ·Assist in  data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation  .  ·Provide  production support and troubleshooting  for Salesforce issues.  ·Maintain clear documentation including  BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams  .  ·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive  continuous improvement and system optimization  .  Required Qualifications:   ·3–6 years of experience  as a Business Analyst with  Salesforce platform exposure  .  ·Strong understanding of  Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud  .  ·Experience with  requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management  .  ·Knowledge of  Agile/Scrum methodologies  .  ·Ability to create  user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications  .  ·Experience with  Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration  .  ·Strong  analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

description:
Empresa está contratando Immigration paralegal (portuguese speaker) em jaraguá do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Company Description  Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages.  Role Description   We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized  Family-Based Immigration Paralegal  to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment.  Key Responsibilities   Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents  Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy  Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups  Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries  Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance  Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials  Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs) Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations  Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism    Qualifications   Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases  Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures  Excellent organizational and time-management skills  Strong written and verbal communication abilities  Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment  Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only    ﻿  To Apply    To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to . Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Risk management officer
description:
Confira a vaga para Risk management officer em jandira. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:

Job Title:  Implementation Analyst English Resume Only  Location:  Brazil  Type:  Full-Time Contract  Setup:  Fully Remote  Level:  Mid-Level  Industry:  Software SAAS Company  Shift:  US Hours  Start Date:  can start in 2 weeks after offer  Equipment:  Available upon request  Rate:  R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group   The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.  About the Opportunity   Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.  The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.  Responsibilities   Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.  Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.  Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.  Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.  Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.  Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.  Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.  Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.  Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.    Qualifications   At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.  Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.  Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.  Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.  Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.  Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.  Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.  Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.  Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

description:
Nova oportunidade para English teacher em bento gonçalves. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Job Title:  Implementation Analyst English Resume Only  Location:  Brazil  Type:  Full-Time Contract  Setup:  Fully Remote  Level:  Mid-Level  Industry:  Software SAAS Company  Shift:  US Hours  Start Date:  can start in 2 weeks after offer  Equipment:  Available upon request  Rate:  R$8,000 - R$10,000 About The Methodical Group   The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as Exact Talent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.  About the Opportunity   Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a Saa S platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.  The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.  Responsibilities   Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.  Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.  Configure and customize the Saa S platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.  Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.  Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.  Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.  Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.  Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.  Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.    Qualifications   At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise Saa S products.  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.  Strong understanding of Saa S platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.  Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.  Experience using tools such as Wrike, Hub Spot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.  Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.  Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.  Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.  Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.  Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.
